NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2025

SANTA CLARA, Calif., Feb. 26, 2026 — NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today reported revenue for the fourth quarter ended January 26, 2026, of $39.3 billion, up 78% from a year ago.

Cash Flow Information

Cash flow from operating activities was $16.6 billion for the fourth quarter, up from $11.5 billion in the prior-year period. Capital expenditures totaled $1.1 billion, resulting in free cash flow of $15.5 billion.
